terminals.name: exa-mcp-http
terminals.description: Exa MCP server over Streamable HTTP on http://localhost:8081/mcp (POST). Protocol methods (initialize, tools/list, resources/read) work without credentials. Set the EXA_API_KEY secret to enable live web_search_exa / web_fetch_exa calls; without it, tool calls return a clear 401 asking for an API key.
